generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The removal of the nested field validation check for TSDB mode (`if (lookup.nestedLookup() != NestedLookup.EMPTY)`) should be accompanied by a comment explaining why this is safe to do in TSDB mode. This will help future maintainers understand the reasoning behind this change.

review_comment: Maybe we should add an assert that `getRoutingFields()` doesn't return a reference to `RoutingFields.Noop#INSTANCE`? Just to make sure we are able to collect dimension values in order to generate _tsid / _id at a later stage?
